LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a describing word

3. When practising Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
